items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Ernie hung around us all the time.

ctx.x: Well, Ernie Anderson used to be the PR man for -- he loved Louis all his life. In fact, he's the guy set up Nixkin the Village and all those -- Eddie Condons and all, because he loved jazz. But he's a brainy guy. He lives in London, and he's PR man. So Ernie hung around us all the time. And Ernie, when we made big tunes, Joe Glazer would
stand there, and I guess they paid him big money to go with us, and Ernie -- and Louis was real tight.
